item.title: Dell UltraSharp 52 Thunderbolt Hub Monitor review: A workstation in a single display
item.summary: The Dell UltraSharp 52 is designed to do more than give you extra screen space. With a built-in Thunderbolt dock, KVM switch and expansive 5K2K display, it aims to replace an entire desktop setup. After several weeks of use, here's whether it succeeds.
